test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) MO - LP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d082d49933b868a9e9c40dba3febac97b4df00e5cb36611ecf544e8d2e38a46.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1347667d8fe2328418400fecbf50c16fc98c3e4f2010d37c4479453fd7d4453.png] 

Option 2) OQ - NS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f76a074e1a2fe8e0ac99fa0d3c7d7219f25e192b19199bf7b0d59bcd6d283a7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7706a4177238b523c6d17d46612e05c2678f5b93dcd773af0d722f37dcc4d53.png] 

Option 3) TV-SW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb04af4f45080dcb7ce000afb61693b6896020320dc0dc28df366f00385f0e83.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5abe8f9f54f5bd66287786decae6a92d0c1072fb36bfe6e40b6188b1f40e3c3e.png] 

Option 4) GI - FJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b193bea7bfc96f32d1dec60b1586b75525b48e4158c7680b06873d4269d6294.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03c0761c1ffd8622d91ac43b2d1c0c5f1f601595b59f398bbfccb4efeb9d2a4c.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'OQ - NS' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
